chapter: Dancers, Newton, Chu Berry and the Cab Calloway band
title: Replacing Leroy Maxey in Cab Calloway's band
summary: Cole replaces Maxey, who left for Kansas City then illness.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: When you went with Cab you replaced Leroy Maxey who had been with him for a long time.
Been with him as long as I knew. There was a Cab Calloway.
Right. Why did he decide to leave?
I don't know. I think Leroy had been with Cab so long I guess he wanted to go back home to Kansas City, I know that's where I saw him. We played Kansas City.
Yeah, it says Leroy remained with Cab until November, 1938, when serious illness forced him to retire from full time music. Has lived for many years in Flint, Michigan.
I didn't know that was his home.
Apparently still alive as of this book which this edition is about a year old. So he's probably still alive.
Still alive probably. I haven't seen Leroy
since then, since we were in Kansas City.
